map.基于 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式计算基础代谢率（BMR），结合活动系数: Compute the basal metabolic rate (BMR) using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula and combine it with an activity factor to obtain the total daily energy expenditure (TDEE).
map.BMR = 10×体重 + 6.25×身高 − 5×年龄 + 性别常数；TDEE: BMR = 10×weight + 6.25×height − 5×age + sex constant; TDEE = BMR × activity factor
map.采用 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式：男性性别常数 +5、女性 −161（: Uses the Mifflin-St Jeor formula: sex constant +5 for men and −161 for women (weight in kg, height in cm, age in years). TDEE (total daily energy expenditure) = BMR × activity factor (1.2 sedentary to 1.9 very intense). Target calories: fat loss = TDEE − 500 kcal/day, maintenance = TDEE, muscle gain = TDEE + 300 kcal/day.
map.💡 Mifflin-St Jeor：男 BMR = 10×kg + 6.25×c: 💡 Mifflin-St Jeor: men BMR = 10×kg + 6.25×cm − 5×age + 5; women = 10×kg + 6.25×cm − 5×age − 161. TDEE = BMR × activity factor.
map.减脂建议每日热量缺口 300-500 kcal，增肌建议盈余 200-400 k: For fat loss a daily calorie deficit of 300-500 kcal is recommended, and for muscle gain a surplus of 200-400 kcal
map.活动系数为经验估算，实际消耗因人而异: The activity factor is an empirical estimate; actual expenditure varies from person to person
map.孕妇、哺乳期、青少年及病患请遵医嘱，不适用本公式: Pregnant, breastfeeding, adolescent and ill individuals should follow medical advice; this formula does not apply to them
map.长期热量摄入不应低于 BMR，以免影响基础代谢: Long-term calorie intake should not fall below BMR, to avoid affecting basal metabolism
map.减脂/增肌前测算每日总消耗: Measure total daily expenditure before fat loss / muscle gain
map.，定减脂/维持/增肌三档热量目标。: , and set three calorie targets for fat loss / maintenance / muscle gain.
map.对比 BMR 与 TDEE，理解活动系数对总能耗的影响。: Compare BMR with TDEE to understand the effect of the activity factor on total expenditure.
map.按目标配宏量（蛋白/脂肪/碳水），落地面食计划。: Allocate macros (protein/fat/carbs) by goal and put the diet plan into practice.
map.可复现算例：30 岁男性 TDEE 与三档目标: Reproducible example: TDEE and three target tiers for a 30-year-old man
map.输入：男、30 岁、175 cm、70 kg、活动系数 1.55（中度）。\nB: Input: male, 30 years, 175 cm, 70 kg, activity factor 1.55 (moderate). BMR=10×70+6.25×175−5×30+5=1648.75≈1649 kcal; TDEE=1649×1.55=2556 kcal; TDEE (kJ)=2556×4.184≈10690 kJ. Three tiers: fat loss=2556−500=2056, maintenance=2556, muscle gain=2556+300=2856 kcal/day. Macros (maintenance): protein=70×1.6=112 g, fat=2556×0.25/9≈71 g, carbs=(2556−112×4−71×9)/4≈367 g.
map.减脂建议每日缺口 300–500 kcal（约 0.3–0.5 kg/周），增肌: For fat loss a daily deficit of 300-500 kcal is recommended (about 0.3-0.5 kg/week) and for muscle gain a surplus of 200-400 kcal. Too large a deficit easily costs muscle and is hard to sustain; intake should not stay below BMR for long.
map.维持期常见蛋白 1.6 g/kg、脂肪 25% 热量、余下碳水；减脂期提高蛋白占: In maintenance, a common split is protein 1.6 g/kg, fat 25% of calories and the rest carbs; during fat loss, raise the protein share to preserve muscle and slightly lower carbs; during muscle gain, raise carbs. The ratios can be fine-tuned to the training goal; this tool gives maintenance reference values.
map.采用国际通用的 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式估算基础代谢率，并结合日常活: Uses the internationally common Mifflin-St Jeor formula to estimate the basal metabolic rate and combines it with the daily activity level to compute the total daily energy expenditure (TDEE), providing calorie-target references for fat loss, maintenance and muscle gain.
map.减脂/维持/增肌三档目标: Three target tiers: fat loss / maintenance / muscle gain
